extraction_notes: Main article contains additional catalytic results in Supporting Information (Figures S17, S19–S22) for conversion/selectivity and other samples, but the SI data themselves were not included in the provided full text/images; those entries were not extracted. Main-text figures are bar charts; values not printed in text were read approximately from labelled axes and marked with qualifier '~'. Duplicates for the same catalyst/temperature are included where the paper reports STY on different normalization bases (per g Cu and per g catalyst), because the schema has one methanol_sty field.
